description: The bottom safe inset of a modal sheet (schema 9.31.0, rules: x-style.layout.sheetSafeBottom). Written by hand; one table for every reader. «placementCases» — where the reader adds the bottom inset of the platform: «root» is the bottom padding inside the box of the screen root (the sheet box: its background and radius reach the physical bottom), «zone» is the room under the content of the bottom zone (the same rule as on a page, x-style.layout.bottomZone.safeArea); never both. «input.areaWidth» is the width of the area the host gave the screen (it decides sheet or window, x-style.layout.wideModal); «input.safeBottom» is the inset as the host gave it (a host that accounted for it itself gives 0); «input.bottomZone» — the screen has a SHOWN bottom zone (a pinned block; a navigation bar is not drawn in a modal layer). Page rows restate the rule of 9.12.0 and do not change. «geometryCases» — the sheet box in logical points from the top of the area: «contentHeight» is the content of the sheet with the root paddings and its bottom zone, WITHOUT the inset; «contentBottom» is the bottom edge of the content above the inset, from the top of the sheet. «ruleCases» — data of the block.

placementCases.name: a sheet without a bottom zone: the inset inside the box, under the content
a sheet without a bottom zone on a device without a home indicator: nothing
the word bottom: the same as no field
an unknown placement word reads as bottom: a sheet
a sheet with a pinned block: the inset under the content of the zone, once
a sheet with a pinned block on a device without a home indicator: nothing
a sheet on an Android gesture bar
the host accounted for the inset itself and gives zero
an inset that is not a number: zero
a fractional inset is not rounded
the last compact width: still a sheet
a window in the centre: no inset inside the layer
a window in the centre with a pinned block: no inset
a sheet on a medium area is a window: no inset
a sheet on an expanded area is a window: no inset, with a pinned block too
a page without a bottom zone: unchanged, nothing
a page without the field presentation: unchanged, nothing
a page with a bottom zone: unchanged, under the zone

geometryCases.name: a short sheet grows by the inset and stays at the bottom
no inset: the sheet as before 9.31.0
content with the inset exactly fills the area: it does not scroll
a tall sheet: the area height, the body scrolls above the inset
with a pinned block the arithmetic is the same: the inset is under the zone
an inset that is not a number: zero

ruleCases.name: without a bottom zone: inside the sheet box
with a bottom zone: under the content of the zone
a sheet shown as a window: none
